parallels.note: Aaron spoke all the words which Yahweh had spoken to Moses, and did the signs in the sight of the people.
Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, and gave them a command to the children of Israel, and to Pharaoh king of Egypt, to…
“When Pharaoh speaks to you, saying, ‘Perform a miracle!’ then you shall tell Aaron, ‘Take your rod, and cast it down…
